assets.title: Fixed Raised Pet Grooming Wash Station
assets.description: Original fixed raised pet-care washing station with one thick true basin cavity, blind sump floor, nine standing slats with eight real slots, two interior bearing ledges, four grounded legs and connected frame, a tall splashback and a fixed hose with parked hand spray. Basin width1.16m and depth.64m, standing surface .64m, rim .88m; 53mm clear space beneath the grate. Independent named editable components in one static assembly. QA rectangular envelope only establishes empty-cavity geometry, not fit for any real animal. No animal model, access ramp, hydraulic lift, flowing water, hose motion, plumbing, load, waterproof, sanitary, veterinary or grooming-safety certification.
